messages:
maria: Heads-up — alert flooded with Xid 45 and 79 on us-west-gpu-pool after driver-535.2 canary (10 nodes). Avg p95 latency +120ms, some pods OOM'ed. Cloudwatch shows GPU resets.

alan: seeing same in prometheus: nccl_watchdog_timeouts spike 02:12–02:18 UTC. Canary tag: driver:535.2 kernel:5.15.8. Also correlates with kernel patch rolled yesterday.

sre-bot: ALERT: HIGH - GPU_XID_SPIKE - us-west - 10 nodes - 02:14 UTC - Top codes: 45, 79 - /alerts/1976543210

jen: @maria can you paste nvml/dmesg? run `kubectl -n gpu-ops logs -l canary=true --since=1h | grep -i xid | tail -n 200`

maria: pasted nvml snippet:
```
GPU 2: Xid 45 Timeout on channel
GPU 5: Xid 79 Illegal memory access
```
and dmesg shows repeated `nvidia: GPU reset` and `nvidia-modeset: GPU UNPLUG`.

leo: quick mitigation: scale down canary to 2 nodes, label node-pool `driver-rollback-eligible=true`, then schedule rollback.

alan: also seeing NCCL watchdog messages: `ncclWatchdog: thread timed out after 120s` — our default is 120s for short seqs, suspicious for this workload.

maria: started smoke on rollback candidate (driver 533.8). Running NCCL all-reduce stress + 30m CI.

maria: smoke results: 0 Xid observed in 1h on those nodes.

deploy-bot: Started rollout: driver rollback to 533.8 on us-west canary group - job id r-1976543210-rollback

ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook excerpt: 1) set canary size=2 2) rollback driver to last-known-good 3) monitor p95 and Xid metrics for 60m 4) escalate to eng-sre if >5 Xid events in 30m

alan: propose temporarily silence noisy Xid alert for canaries to avoid alert fatigue, keep pages for prod pools. Any objections?

jen: ok to suppress for canaries but add alert annotation "suppressed during rollback" and create follow-up ticket.

leo: cost note: rollback + extra testing ~8 GPU-hours at $3/GPU-hr (~$24) immediate; if we shift traffic to eu-west there are spare GPUs but egress costs will rise.

maria: executed rollback at 02:35 UTC. monitoring: p95 back to baseline, Xid events dropped to 0 after 02:40.

alan: leaving canary suppression window until 03:30, watchlist in place.

jen: we should add a pre-upgrade CI gate: kernel+driver compatibility smoke that runs NCCL stress on a small k8s job. Filing INFRA-1243.

leo: long-term ask: add a kernel-driver compatibility matrix to our model catalog and block scheduled rollouts for unsupported combos. Low effort to automate, high ROI.

maria: TL;DR: rollback successful. Mitigations: tighten canary gating, add smoke tests, follow-ups INFRA-1243, annotate alert suppression, update runbook.

alan: thanks — closing thread unless further symptoms. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: NOTE: Incident closed by maria at 03:02 UTC. Metrics: Xid events 42 -> 0 in 26m. Tagging incident INF-1976543210"
